text:
Alex K: Heads up — after yesterday's CU12 image rebuild in eu-west we started seeing node drain flaps and some NCCL hangs on mixed-compiler pools.
Sasha V: Repro is pretty small: jobs using model-serving pool B (mixed gcc11/gcc13 hosts) hit repeated `ncclCommInitRank` stalls and then pods stuck in Terminating.
Sasha V: Log snippet:
```
[2026-03-16T03:14:22Z] ERROR tensorflow: cuda runtime version mismatch: expected 11.x loaded 12.0
[2026-03-16T03:14:23Z] WARN nccl: NCCL WARN Call to cudaGetDevice failed: unhandled system error
[2026-03-16T03:14:23Z] ERROR ld.so: /opt/cuda/lib64/libstdc++.so.6: undefined symbol: _ZSt17__throw_out_of_range_fmtPKcz
```
Infra Bot: CI pipeline rebuilt images: `cu12-runtime:20260316` (artifacts: repo.redwood/ci/cu12-runtime:20260316)
Mike R: Likely cause: toolkit built with gcc13/GLIBCXX ABI but host node runtime (kernel/libstdc++) is older. Mixed nodes end up loading vendor `libstdc++` from images -> symbol mismatch.
Clair T: We're also seeing modprobe churn on some nodes after the new driver bundles were installed, kernel taints popped and kubelet restarted, which explains the pod churn.
Ops Lead: Impact: some canary and prod queues routed to fallback capacity (older p3 pools) -> short-term cost spike ~22% and queuing latency increased.
Alex K: Short-term mitigation ideas: 1) taint CU12-rebuilt nodes (no-schedule) 2) tag images as cu12-canary and pin a small canary set 3) rollback agent that pushes previous cu11 image
Sasha V: Confirmed patch: if we force host-provided libstdc++ (LD_PRELOAD unset vendor lib) some services recover, but not all (kernel module versions still a mismatch).
Mike R: Proposed fix: rebuild cu12 images using the host toolchain or produce slim runtime that relies on host libstdc++. We'll also build a gcc11-compatible flavor.
Clair T: Ops action: I'm tainting nodes in eu-west pool B now and moving running critical jobs to dedicated stable pool.
Ops Lead: I'm monitoring spend; opened ticket FIN-3421 to capture short-term overage.
Alex K: Owners: Mike -> rebuild variants and publish artifacts; Clair -> node taint/rollback coordination; Sasha -> validation harness and canary tests. I'll schedule a 30m bridge if rollback doesn't clear by +1h. :eyes:
Sasha V: I'll add the `ldd`/`readelf` checks into the CI image lint and add a test for libstdc++ ABI compatibility.
Infra Bot: Incident note created: INCIDENT-2026-0316-CU12-REBUILD.
Ops Lead: Thanks — keep updates here.
